title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
authorBio: English novelist and social critic, the greatest of the Victorian era.
description: Miserly Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three ghosts who show him the error of his ways.
excerpt: Marley was dead: to begin with. There is no doubt whatever about that...

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
authorBio: English writer, mathematician, and photographer. Known for his wordplay and imaginative fiction.
description: A young girl falls through a rabbit hole into a fantastical underground world filled with peculiar creatures and absurd situations.
excerpt: Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do...
